prompts.military_planning: Use case: style-transfer. Edit target: the single supplied black-and-white military planning photograph. Colorize this exact photograph realistically. Preserve the exact wide composition and crop, positions and silhouettes of every person and hand, the map and its markings, clothing cuts, photographic grain, lighting and tonal contrast. The cropped heads must stay cropped; do not invent faces or expand the view. Subdued natural colors: muted olive-grey military uniforms, natural skin tones, aged pale beige map paper, dark brown wooden table where visible. Retain all details; colorization only, no additional objects, no emblems, no text, no borders, no sharpening or stylized painting, no sepia-only tint. Opaque horizontal image, original aspect ratio 507:184, fill the entire frame with the original scene.
prompts.factory_workshop: Use case: style-transfer. Edit target: the single supplied black-and-white factory workshop photograph. Colorize this exact photograph realistically. Preserve the exact wide composition and crop, every worker's face, body and hand position, the long cylindrical metal workpieces, all machinery, perspective, lighting and documentary photographic grain. Subdued natural colors: natural skin tones, faded blue-grey and beige work clothes, dark charcoal aprons, neutral silver steel cylinders, muted grey-green industrial machinery and warm grey factory interior. Metallic surfaces must remain neutral metal with realistic reflections. Colorization only, no new objects or people, no text, no logos, no borders, no cinematic grading, no sepia-only tint. Opaque horizontal image, original aspect ratio 507:184, fill the entire frame with the original scene.
